title: GameGo：基于真实资产合成轨迹训练游戏开发智能体
summary: GameGo 将简短游戏创意转化为完整产品需求文档，通过动态压缩保留核心玩法约束，构建了包含 55,060 条开发轨迹的 GameGoData 数据集与 124 个查询的 GameGoBench 基准，训练出的 GameGoCoder 在游戏开发任务上超越同类基线，接近前沿模型水平。
summary_en: GameGo transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents using task-specific dynamic compression to preserve gameplay constraints. It builds GameGoData with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D/2.5D/3D games and GameGoBench with 124 queries. Training GameGoCoder on this data outperforms matched baselines and approaches frontier models on gamedev benchmarks.
